name: Arrow Blocks
summary: Shows which way hoppers, dispensers, droppers and observers send their items or signal, with small arrows right on the blocks.
logoPrompt: A grey metal funnel block with a bold white arrow on its side pointing to the right

cover.tagline: Read your redstone at a glance.

description: **Arrow Blocks draws small arrows on the blocks that move items or signals, so you can read a contraption at a glance.**
- Hoppers: arrows on the sides of the funnel (all four when it points down, two when sideways) and on the floor inside a sideways hopper, pointing where items go.
- Dispensers and droppers: arrows on the four sides around the front, pointing at the front where items come out.
- Observers: arrows on the two plain sides, pointing to the back where the signal leaves, like the triangle on top.
- The arrows turn with the block in all six directions.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Only the look of four blocks changes, so you can add or remove it anytime.
- Fronts, backs and items in your inventory keep their vanilla look.
- Another resource pack that changes these blocks wins if it sits higher in the list.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want arrows on more blocks? Leave a comment.
